preferences.name: authMode
preferences.title: Connection Method
preferences.description: Sign in with FirmLedger (recommended): secure OAuth in your browser, no key to copy. API Key: paste a key from Dashboard → Developer API.

preferences.description: Only used when the connection method is API Key. Tick read:listings, plus read:account and write:account for account tools (Pro).
